question.text: In the Indian cash segment, which of the following clearing corporations exist?

answer.text: NSE Clearing Limited (NCL) and Indian Clearing Corporation Limited (ICCL)
NSE Clearing Limited (NCL) and MCX Clearing Corporation Limited
BSE Clearing Corporation and NSE Clearing

explanation.text: The Logic: In India's cash segment, the two clearing corporations are NSE Clearing Limited (NCL) and Indian Clearing Corporation Limited (ICCL). The Trap: The other options pair NCL/ICCL with entities not identified by the source as cash-segment clearing corporations. Note: The source statement is limited to identifying NCL and ICCL as the cash-segment CCs.
